list:
# "First you'll need to bring the rune, That sees our world bloom": 
#: Nature rune, since Nature is associated with flower growth.
# "The next one you'll find is grown, From the seed of the tomb.": 
#: A tomb is a repository for the remains of the dead. In the prerequisite quest Waterfall, once you use Glarial's urn on the Chalice of Eternity, you are rewarded with 40 mithril seeds, from which you can grow flowers. 
#: Alternatively, Irit leaf is strongly connected to death according to Gielinor's flora - herbs, and is, at least in lore, often found growing in graveyards.
# "With them you must place a knife, That darkness has claimed": 
#: Black knife or black dagger are knives "claimed" by the darkest colour of black.
# "And in defiance of the chaotic lord, Place the liquid he has named.": 
#: Zamorak is the god of Chaos. Wine of Zamorak or Zamorak brew are liquids carrying his name.
# "Next you must seek a chain, That will not compromise": 
#: Adamant chainbody because adamant means unyielding, synonymous with unwilling to compromise, and chainbodies are made of chain.
# "Bring lastly that which is green, And most humans despise.": 
#: Upon eating a Cabbage, the message is displayed.
